Get Involved

Events

If you support LGBTQ equality, you’re a part of the Equality Ohio family. Come see us at an event near you to learn more or take action — and help us make Ohio a state we can all call home.

Save the Date

Upcoming events

Evening for Equality · Dayton

The Roadmap Back to Equality

Thursday, August 27, 2026
5:30 PM arrival · 6:45 PM program
Private home in the Deweese Park neighborhood, Dayton — address provided upon RSVP.

Equality Ohio’s CEO and ED Dwayne Steward and the Obergefell & Arthur Society invite you for a conversation with Jim Obergefell, plaintiff in the historic marriage equality case, to learn how Ohioans can join the journey back to equality.

No cost to attend. Plentiful street parking available. Please RSVP by Monday, August 24.

Special thanks to the host committee and sponsors, including Gary Greenberg & Margie McLellan; Randle B. Moore, III & Ronald A. Frost, Jr.; Kristin Powell; and Lynn Readey & Sandy Anderson.

RSVP for Dayton
Signature Fall Event

Advocates & Allies 2026

Thursday, October 1, 2026
6–8 PM reception · Happy hour add‑on 5–6 PM with special guests (announcements coming soon)
The Fives, 550 Reach Blvd, Columbus, OH 43215

Equality Ohio’s signature fall event honoring the advocates across the spectrum, from joy as resistance to policy wins. Plus, learn how you can help fund the fight ahead on Ohio’s Roadmap Back to Equality.

Join us for program updates, an awards ceremony, and entertainment, along with heavy appetizers and drinks available.

Interested in sponsoring this event? Reach out.
